lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the fifth branchial slit, organized into approximately four horizontal strata across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs to form a coordinate-style grid of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three longitudinal ridges on the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-density high-luminance blobs on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin; at least two elongated dark silhouettes (likely remoras) are visible ventrally.
